name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Commands for the owner (o-cmds)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-cmds markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Commands for the owner (o-cmds)

When you give the owner a command or a multi-step recipe to run (build and play, open a page, run a check), also record it in o-cmds so they can list, view and run it later: `o-cmds cmd add --name <short-slug> --desc "<what it does>"` with the script on stdin, or through the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `cmds.cmd add`). Make the script self-contained (cd and any temp env inside it), and never put secrets or machine-specific host details in it. Tell the owner the command's name; they run it with `o-cmds cmd run NAME|N` or from the `o-cmds` TUI (newest at the bottom).
